changes.comment: BREAKING: Review: every Agent Runtime and Channel provider must be rewritten against the replaced contracts; there are no compatibility aliases and an old provider fails to load. No rebuild is needed for local state. `AgentRuntimeProvider` now exposes `start`/`submit`/`stop` with provider-owned session identity, mandatory continuous recovery, mandatory session-bound structured output, a leased push state sink, optional live activity, and neutral recent Activity Records; `submit` takes final text only, so no source taxonomy, channel identifier, dedupe policy, or `waitIdle` crosses the seam. `ChannelProvider` replaces `ChannelRoutes` with direct lifecycle plus an `invoke` port and an event source, and adds the caller-scoped Channel MCP composition types. Core binding, `ChannelOrigin`, and every Collaboration Space type are removed, and the canonical Command and Team/TeamMate event envelopes are published here.
